name: Anita Hewitt
original_name: アニタ ヒューイット
source:
[url=/c93183]Frederick[/url]'s mother.
A wealthy woman. She got married to [url=/c93187]Henry Pearson[/url] at a young age.
However, unable to bear his eccentricity, she divorced a few years later.
